axes.proposal: Arabic text exists only in page files. Display = page slice at the resolved span minus a closed, tested deletion list (footnote markers; intra-span paragraph break becomes one space). Sigla stay or the span ends before them. Selector exact is a checked locator, never displayed. model:check asserts render(span)==slice minus markers. A book's ayah quotation renders as printed; Ayah row linked beside, differences flagged, never substituted.

Two records: Statement (report, span(s), speaker via Report voice, role per ADR 0011) and Assertion (predicate from closed vocab; value = spans | object | parsed | classified; restsOn Statements). Every subject/object is a Mention id reached through Identification, never a bare slug. Heading-subject identifications are explicit-in-text and bulk-reviewed in one screen per entry. Plain Siyar value ≈6 records.

Report has voice (transmitted, author with basis span, editor-footnote, reported-anonymous) and Chain = ordered (Link|Gap). Link: narrator Mention, modeSpans[] non-overlapping, modeKey 1:1 printed lemma+person/number; abbreviations (ثنا، أنا) map to full key keeping abbreviation span. Derived jazm/tamrid view never replaces modeKey. Gap anywhere (ta'liq, mursal, balagha), never inferred, no edge across. enclosedBy for book quotations. Edition.riwayah chain. Unmapped formula fails check.

One global Entity per person. Identification needs basis spans with role EDITOR_NOTE, RIJAL_ENTRY or SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT (entry heading, يعني); the mention's own span is never basis; no namaq-authored basis. No basis = unidentified text, no node. Competing sourced identifications all DISPUTED. Reuse per chain segment within one work, applications listed, reviewed once plus sample. Edges only from reviewed identifications.

Tradition groups unmerged Reports through Membership records with typed basis (editor-takhrij span, atraf-index span, same-origin-and-matn, namaq-authored). Wordings never merged; diff computed. namaq-authored allowed for non-Prophetic material, labelled 'grouped by Namaq'. Grouping of marfu' hadith requires a takhrij/editor/atraf span unless the owner relaxes it (open question).

Minted record ids; per-record publication. Revision hash = record fields + sha256(render(span)) + witness id for every span reached. Re-anchor with identical rendered text keeps publication; any display change lapses exactly those records and model:check lists them. Only the owner runs publish, per change set listing record ids and hashes.

Authored: data/works/<work>/{work.yaml, editions/witnesses, units/<unit>.yaml}, data/history/sources/<edition>/<witness>/v<n>/, data/entities/, data/glosses/ (English names, marked Namaq's). PR = change set. PostgreSQL, Neo4j derived. catalog/ and batches/ retired, seeds archived read-only. NARRATED_FROM in a separate isnad view excluded from centrality, from reviewed identifications only, carrying modeKey and span ids. ADR supersedes 0010 layout.

Phase 0 freeze, tag pre-span-model, matchSpan/render module. 1 text core and works/witnesses. 2 Siyar conversion with per-statement voice and review surface. 3 projection with dual tables one release, rollback criterion. 4 Siyar chains and identifications. 5 one Bukhari kitab with measured cost go/no-go. 6 legacy close-out. Old excerpts archived.

Work/Edition/Volume/Witness. Witness flags per volume range: vowelled, footnotes, ligature insertion. Shamela only until owner changes it; bare Sira v1-2 shown with fidelity flag. Edition.riwayah held. Bukhari edition and a numbering mapping table, Ayah mushaf and qira'a named in ADRs before phase 5.

Agents propose; owner publishes. Prophetic statements (P10): complete chain record with explicit gaps, no default speaker, no LEGACY, honorifics as printed, two distinct recorded reviewers, one hadith-trained. Until a second reviewer exists they stay PROPOSED, visibly. Per-record review surface built in phase 2; segment-level identification review; cost measured in phase 5.

Source text is never hidden. ADR 0008 kept: unreviewed shown with status, LEGACY shown 'no source yet', migration-only, counted to zero. Our judgments about Prophetic material (unreviewed identifications, groupings, gradings attributions) produce no edges or labels until reviewed; recorded as a scoped ADR 0008 exception confirmed by owner.

extras.rule_or_trigger: Before any public (non-preview) release, owner confirms Shamela terms for re-hosting page text; record the answer in an ADR.
Search index is derived from rendered spans with one versioned search-normalisation (diacritics, hamza, tatweel folded); never stored as authored text.
Quiz questions cite record ids; a lapsed or rejected cited record makes the question fail quiz:validate until re-reviewed.
Each review records reviewer id and qualification tag; P10 needs two distinct ids, one tagged hadith-trained; owner names the reviewer.
Witness records it is a transcription; a suspected host typo is a Collation note for review, never corrected in the page file.
Re-fetch or normalisation bump re-resolves all spans; any rendered change lapses dependents; Prophetic matns re-enter two-review gate.
Abbreviations map to full modeKey keeping their span; doubt words and idraj are Statement insertions with speaker or UNKNOWN, inside the matn span.
Model taqti as Tradition membership with basis 'same-chain-cut'; design when the Bukhari pilot meets its first cut report.
Editor footnotes are reports with editor as speaker; takhrij grades are grading statements; sigla like (ع) are editor-key statements resolved by the edition's key page.
Segment identification is one record applied to listed occurrences; no copied identifications, so no drift.
Before phase 4 chains need bases: owner picks rijal work and ingestion order; qira'a of Ayah named in ADR before tafsir.
Span resolution cached by page hash; model:check budget measured in phase 2; projection tests cover disputed and gap edges.
